entities.name: Hepatitis C virus infection
observations: In a longitudinal study of 20 chronic-HCV patients receiving pegylated IFN-α plus ribavirin, peripheral B-cell CD100 was elevated and increased during treatment in early virological responders; this supports an association, not direct viral induction. (PMID:25436996)

entities.name: CD100 / Sema4D
observations: IFN-α exposure up-regulated B-cell CD100 in vitro and during therapy in chronic-HCV patients; expression returned toward normal after sustained virological response. Causality by HCV itself was not established. (PMID:25436996)

entities.name: Interferon-alpha
observations: IFN-α treatment and in-vitro exposure increased B-cell CD100/Sema4D in evidence from a chronic-HCV study. (PMID:25436996)

entities.name: PMID:25436996
observations: Longitudinal study of 20 chronic-HCV patients treated with pegylated IFN-α plus ribavirin; B-cell CD100 was increased and further up-regulated with IFN-α exposure, but direct HCV causation or CD100-mediated viral clearance was not proven.
